\section[la sete]{la sete — thirst}

\label{lesson:IT-C42-sete}



\begin{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: la sete}
\textbf{la sete} — \textquotedblleft{}thirst\textquotedblright{}. \textbf{ho sete}: I am thirsty.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{sete} $\leftarrow$ Latin \emph{sitis}, \textquotedblleft{}thirst\textquotedblright{} — inherited. (EtymDB 2.1)
\end{cousinweb}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: malato}
\textbf{malato} — \textquotedblleft{}ill, sick\textquotedblright{}.
